svg.title: Sampling and measurement quality
svg.desc: 1. Define the target and accessible population. Check eligibility, coverage and the sampling frame.. 2. Select a justified sampling approach. Probability methods for planned inference, purposive methods for information-rich inquiry.. 3. Choose or develop the instrument. Match content, language, response scale and intended interpretation.. 4. Pilot and standardize. Train collectors, check feasibility, calibrate devices and document procedures.. 5. Evaluate measurement evidence. Reliability, validity, responsiveness or appropriate qualitative rigor.

g.text: The sample and the instrument can introduce different errors.
1. Define the target and accessible population
Check eligibility, coverage and the sampling frame.
Probability methods for planned inference, purposive methods for information-rich inquiry.
Match content, language, response scale and intended interpretation.
Train collectors, check feasibility, calibrate devices and document procedures.
Reliability, validity, responsiveness or appropriate qualitative rigor.
Consistent measurement is not automatically valid measurement.
